title: Kissed Spanish Tomato Gazpacho
description: A peppery, flaky one‑pot gazpacho made from grilled tomatoes, peppers, and fresh thyme, cooked in a clay pot on a robata grill and served chilled.
instructions: Preheat the robata grill to medium‑high heat and place a clay pot on it.
Add the olive oil to the clay pot and swirl to coat the bottom.
Place the tomatoes, bell pepper, onion, and minced garlic in the pot, skin side up, and grill for 8 minutes until charred.
Transfer the grilled vegetables to a heat‑proof bowl and let them cool slightly.
Add the water, red wine vinegar, thyme, salt, and pepper to the bowl and blend until smooth.
Stir in the chopped parsley, then chill the gazpacho in the refrigerator for at least 30 minutes.
Before serving, stir the soup again and pour it into bowls.
Garnish each bowl with a drizzle of olive oil and a sprinkle of fresh thyme.
Serve chilled with a side of crusty bread.
Enjoy the peppery, flaky flavors of this Spanish gazpacho!
